name: project-sentinel
description: Project Sentinel keeps long Claude Code runs on track: a status bar, the Control Room panel, Context Autopilot (automatic handoff to a fresh context), Cache Guardian (the prompt cache in view, kept warm on request), permission categories that ask or deny, a run chain, Frontier Max, a lazy-exit guard, a model router, subagent limits, Focus view, machine load and Kit, an optional pixel companion.
